description: This file provides dependency injection functions for API endpoints in a FastAPI application, including methods for retrieving the current authenticated customer and verifying admin privileges based on JWT tokens and database queries.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents an authenticated customer, with attributes including customer group ID used for authorization checks.

methods.name: Customer get_current_customer( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated customer based on JWT token, raising an HTTPException if authentication fails or customer not found.

methods.name: Customer get_current_admin( customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer) )
methods.description: Verifies that the current customer has admin privileges; raises an exception if not.

ctags.name: get_current_customer
ctags.signature: ( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
